en.html:
ｅｔｃ／駐屯隊伍長"You, woman! Are you the intruder!?"
Kanae"No, she went that way. I am only a nun. The evidence is before you."
ｅｔｃ／駐屯隊Ｄ"C-Corporal... behind her! Third Squad has been wiped out!!"
Kanae"So they have. All lying down. An afternoon nap, perhaps?"
ｅｔｃ／駐屯隊伍長"Kill her!!"
Kanae"Some small hearing for my side, could you not give?"
ｅｔｃ／駐屯隊伍長"Once you're crawling on the ground!"

ja.html:
ｅｔｃ／駐屯隊伍長 「そこの女！ 　侵入者とは貴様かッ!?」
香奈枝 「いえその方ならあっちへ行きました。 　わたくしは見ての通りただの尼さんです」
ｅｔｃ／駐屯隊Ｄ 「ご、伍長殿……女の背後を！ 　第三分隊が殲滅されております!!」
香奈枝 「あら本当みなさんお倒れになって。 　昼寝でもしていらっしゃるのかしら？」
ｅｔｃ／駐屯隊伍長 「殺せぇっ!!」
香奈枝 「少しくらい話を聞いてくださいません？」
ｅｔｃ／駐屯隊伍長 「貴様が地面に這いつくばった後でな！」

ｅｔｃ／駐屯隊伍長"What... did you SAY!?"
Kanae"I too like to have the other person crawling when we talk. Just... this sort of arrangement."
ｅｔｃ／駐屯隊伍長"Y-you... the bullets... dodged...!?"
Kanae"Fufufu."

en.html:
Kanae"Well, now. All by myself I am becoming quite carried away!"
Kanae"Laugh, laugh, laugh—and still it is only me. Everyone around has become a corpse. Not one reply for me."
Kanae"...Such a pitiable figure I make. As though the whole world has left me behind."
Kanae"Fufufu—ahahahaha."
